sentences.text: The current UCB directions cover loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026, and for cases outside the specific Tier 4 and up-to-₹50 lakh Tier 3 rules, pre-payment charges, if any, must be as per the approved policy of a UCB. [E3,E8]

A Tier 3 UCB shall not levy any pre-payment charges on business-purpose loans to MSEs only where the sanctioned amount or limit is up to ₹50 lakh, and this case is for ₹80 lakh so that specific prohibition does not apply. [E6]
The evidence does not include the bank’s approved policy or the sanction date, so it is not possible to determine from the provided record alone whether the 2% charge is a violation. [E3,E8,E12,E14]

missing.searched: Looked for the loan sanction or renewal date needed to apply the January 1, 2026 scope in the UCB directions.
Looked for the bank’s approved policy on pre-payment charges to test whether the 2% charge matches the policy allowed for cases outside paragraphs 261(1) and 261(2).
